description: The chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” illustrates benchmark scores for two models across multiple datasets/metrics using grouped vertical bars. The horizontal axis contains the categorical benchmarks labeled (left to right) GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, with labels rotated diagonally; the axis label is “Dataset and Metrics.” The vertical axis is a linear scale labeled “Score (%)” ranging from 0 to 80 with tick marks at 10-point intervals. Each category shows two adjacent bars keyed by the legend “Model”: a blue bar for “LLaMA-3-8B-it” and an orange bar for “Ours (Iterative RLHF).” Approximate bar heights are: GSM-8K ~80 (blue) and ~80 (orange); MMLU ~66 (blue) and ~65 (orange); HumanEval ~61 (blue) and ~64 (orange); TruthfulQA ~44 (blue) and ~60 (orange); ARC ~59 (blue) and ~64 (orange); MBPP ~61 (blue) and ~60 (orange); LC AlpacaEval-2 ~23 (blue) and ~31 (orange); MT-Bench (×5) ~41 (blue) and ~42 (orange); Chat-Arena-Hard ~20 (blue) and ~29 (orange). The bars are grouped by benchmark (two bars per group) with no stacking, and there is no visual indication that categories are sorted by value or otherwise emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and the legend in the upper right.
